milestones.title: Tim Berners-Lee Posts First WWW Summary
milestones.fact: Tim Berners-Lee publicly posted the first summary of the World Wide Web project on the alt.hypertext newsgroup, officially inviting global developers to join the Web.

milestones.title: First Production 64KB RAM Chip
milestones.fact: IBM researchers unveiled the industry's first working 64-kilobit dynamic RAM chip, dramatically multiplying computer memory capacity.
